name: The First Frost
description: Wen Yifan, by chance, ends up living with her high school classmate Sang Yan, whom she once rejected. They keep their distance until Wen Yifan learns from Sang Yan that she sleepwalks, intertwining their lives once more.

videos.title: Goodbye, Sang Yan. Goodbye, Wen Yi Fan.
videos.overview: Down-on-her-luck news reporter Wen Yifan visits a newly opened restaurant, but soon realizes that it's owned by Sang Yan, her childhood crush.

videos.title: Your Name Is Written on My Heart.
videos.overview: After narrowly escaping an assault by her violent roommate, Wen Yifan and Sang Yan cross paths again as she decides to change her living arrangements.

videos.title: Everyone Needs a Romantic Interest. You're My Romantic Interest.
videos.overview: Fate pushes Wen Yifan and Sang Yan together once more when her moving plans fall through and a fire breaks out at his apartment complex.

videos.title: Rumors. I'll Dispel the Rumors for You.
videos.overview: Wen Yifan has a tense encounter with her sister, and Sang Yan officially moves in. Some old friends stop by for a night of nostalgia.

videos.title: Get Closer, Would You?
videos.overview: A game of Truth or Dare leads to a surprising kiss. Sang Yan stews over his regrets. Wen Yifan's mother asks her to visit for New Year's Eve.

videos.title: I Will Always Be with You. Will You Always Be with Me?
videos.overview: Working through New Year's celebrations, a lonely Wen Yifan struggles to cope. As Sang Yan steps in to keep her company, she reflects on her childhood.

videos.title: A Secret… that Can’t Be Kept
videos.overview: Sang Yan's sister visits and reminisces about the past. After Wen Yifan has a difficult conversation with her aunt, Sang Yan tries to cheer her up.

videos.title: The Sun In the Rain, Dazzling and Warm
videos.overview: A sleepwalking incident has Sang Yan questioning the nature of his relationship with Wen Yifan, who downplays its significance.

videos.title: False of Heart, Honest of Action
videos.overview: Wen Yifan encounters a stalker, but a mysterious stranger with an odd connection to her childhood comes to her rescue. Sang Yan secures a job interview.

videos.title: You Forgot, but I Still Remember
videos.overview: Wen Yifan opens up to her old friend Zhong Siqiao about her personal problems, and another sleepwalking incident raises the stakes for her and Sang Yan.

videos.title: Take Care of Yourself. I’m Always Here.
videos.overview: Sang Yan helps Wen Yifan come to terms with the trauma behind her sleepwalking. Later, she begins an unusual assignment with Mu Chengyun.

videos.title: How to Be Happy? Staying with You
videos.overview: At a party, a tipsy Wen Yifan asks Sang Yan about their graduation ceremony. Mu Chengyun's pursuit sparks jealousy.

videos.title: We Made a Promise: I Want to Be with You
videos.overview: Su Hao'an's secret is exposed. A guilt-ridden Wen Yifan sleepwalks again.

videos.title: Can’t Let Go of My Feelings for You
videos.overview: Panic erupts when Grandpa Su goes missing. When a drunk Sang Yan bares his heart, Wen Yifan is left both moved and unsettled.

videos.title: Marks Left by Love
videos.overview: Zhong Siqiao and Sang Yan learn of Grandpa Su's illness. With tensions rising and much left unsaid, Wen Yifan considers moving out.

videos.title: Happy Birthday. Contented.
videos.overview: After Sang Yan organizes her birthday celebration, Wen Yifan makes a decision and confesses to her friend Zhong Siqiao.

videos.title: The Farthest Distance Is an Unspoken “I Love You”
videos.overview: As their relationship heats up, Sang Yan and Wen Yifan enjoy a dinner date, but the mood sours when her troublemaking sister appears.

videos.title: On My Way to You
videos.overview: Rushed away to report on a landslide, Wen Yi Fan realizes that she may have to break a promise to Sang Yan. Later, she makes a confession.

videos.title: Bai Jiang Doesn’t Mean I’m a Loser But That I Only Lost to You, Wen Shuang Jiang
videos.overview: After Wen Yi Fan and Sang Yan announce their relationship, Su Hao'an wrestles with his feelings for Zhong Si Qiao. Xiang Lang ruins a sensitive moment.

videos.title: To Catch You Every Time You Feel Vulnerable
videos.overview: A phone call interrupts a romantic evening between Wen Yi Fan and Sang Yan. Zhong Si Qiao searches for Su Hao An, and Wen Yi Fan receives bad news.

videos.title: Where Is Hope? Hope Is Everywhere with You in the Future
videos.overview: Reporting on a car crash proves a shocking experience for Wen Yi Fan, who seeks comfort from Sang Yan. Zhong Si Qiao agrees to give Su Hao An a chance.

videos.title: Opportunity Is for You
videos.overview: At a wedding, Mu Cheng Yun apologizes to Wen Yi Fan for his behavior and offers her and Sang Yan his blessing. An unwelcome presence lurks nearby.

videos.title: Where to Hide?
videos.overview: Through moments of poignant vulnerability and introspective reflection, Wen Yi Fan confronts past errors and the internal conflicts that impede her emotional progress.

videos.title: The Reason I Left
videos.overview: Feeling guilty for disrupting Sang Yan's life, Wen Yifan leaves town for Hong Kong. Sang Yan and his friends join forces to search for her there.

videos.title: No Matter Where You Are, I'll Find You
videos.overview: Trying to track down Wen Yifan, Sang Yan uncovers her connection to Che Xingde, who has tormented her since high school.

videos.title: This Time, I Won't Break the Promise
videos.overview: Sang Yan confronts Che Xingde when he harasses women at the restaurant. Then, he heads to Hong Kong to find Wen Yifan, who now works at a dance studio.

videos.title: I Accept My Imperfections
videos.overview: An old injury hinders Wen Yifan's preparation for a dance contest. If Zhong Siqiao and Su Hao'an ever locate her, will she come home?

videos.title: I Want a Second Chance, If There's One
videos.overview: Wen Yifan reports on a disturbing crime for which Che Xingde is the prime suspect. Then, she rushes to be with a distressed Sang Yan.

videos.title: Love Means Being Each Other's Light
videos.overview: Overcome with worry, Wen Yifan helps Sang Yan to recover. The authorities make an arrest, and Wen Yifan's sister pays her a visit.

videos.title: Relying: Trusting You in Weakness, Chosen by You Firmly
videos.overview: As Sang Yan continues to heal, Wen Yifan receives a surprise visitor at work. Su Hao'an's family finds closure.

videos.title: Loving You, From the First Day to Forever
videos.overview: As the Spring Festival approaches, Wen Yifan prepares a special dance for Sang Yan, who invites her to visit his family to celebrate the new year.

videos.title: I Long for Someone to Love Me Fiercely Until Death. It's You.
videos.overview: Moving out of the apartment, Wen Yifan finds a touching memento hidden away. Sang Yan makes bold plans to ask her a life-changing question.
